'''K4-76A''' was a [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] and the [[Pilot/Legends|co-pilot]] of [[Tarryn Rayzer]] during the [[Cloud City Grand Prix/Legends|Cloud City Grand Prix]] with specific programming to avoid destroying other [[Racer/Legends|racers]].
